title: Relative pseudo-coherence of derived objects on algebraic spaces
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $g:X\to Y$ a locally finite type morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$, using the existing small ringed model and canonical derived scheme-chart restriction [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus]. For $m\in\mathbf Z$, define $K$ to be $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $Y$ if for every commutative square $U\to V$, $U\to X$, $V\to Y$ with $U,V$ schemes and the vertical maps etale, the corresponding Zariski derived object $K|_U$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $V$ [def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Define relative pseudo-coherence by this condition for every integer $m$. The covers and closed embeddings in the scheme condition may depend on $m$ and on the charts. The Lean predicate records local finite type of each scheme chart map along with the scheme condition; on the stated locally finite type domain these witnesses are automatic.
